title: Add EAS AI STUDIO to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [EAS AI STUDIO](https://www.ekin-ai-studio.my.id) to image
- Create collaborative images using the Pollinations image API

Fixes #13857

gist.headline: A new canvas blooms
gist.blurb: EAS AI STUDIO joined the garden. Bring collaborators, bring prompts, and let the pixels sort out the rest.
gist.summary: Added EAS AI STUDIO to the app directory, highlighting a collaborative image-making tool built with the Pollinations image API.
gist.impact: People browsing Pollinations-powered projects can now find EAS AI STUDIO and use it to create images together.
gist.visual_concept: Depict EAS AI STUDIO as a cozy shared art desk: Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, helps several floating pixel canvases grow from a flower-filled workspace while a retro monitor shows collaborators placing colorful image tiles. The scene represents collaborative image generation through the Pollinations API, with code-plants and a prominently lime-green canvas glow.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny painter's beret as she arranges shared pixel-art canvases with friendly hands reaching in from a cozy studio desk; a retro monitor displays simple pixel text: 'EAS AI STUDIO', with code-plants, flowers, and a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glowing canvas. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, chunky sprites, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
